title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-07
source: Composite from 3 different source reels; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)-Processing (izotope oZone 6) by Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Good‑sound soundboard capture of a summer ’69 show with an unusual long jam and Janis‑Pigpen duet, though fans are split on Janis’s vocals.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, strong sound despite being a relatively obscure 1969 summer concert. The performance features a standout extended jam (highlighted on “Doin’ That Rag”) and memorable moments with Janis Joplin and Pig Pen, but opinions diverge sharply on Janis’s singing, making the overall reception mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is mixed (polarizing views on Janis) while recording quality is consistently praised as good; combined weighting yields a mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers note the audio sounds really good and clear for an old 1969 tape, with no major dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A random summer‑69 set blending Jerry Garcia‑lead tunes with Janis Joplin and Pig Pen contributions; the show feels a bit rough overall but is buoyed by an extended jam and unique vocal collaborations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as the primary songwriter ('Mostly Jerry tunes') and generally viewed positively.
